title: Unreleased photo of massive triangle over water

tellings.quote: they're they're there the one is a massive triangle above the water I mean this thing is huge

plain: There is an unreleased photograph of a huge triangular object hanging above water, according to a CIA contractor named Bob Maguire, who says he has seen it himself. He tells Michels it is among several such images: "the one is a massive triangle above the water I mean this thing is huge." If true, a picture of a giant unexplained craft exists and has never been made public.
